info.description: Dokumentasi API untuk pengelolaan pendaftaran Praktik Kerja Lapangan (PKL).
info.title: API Sistem Informasi Pendaftaran PKL - Telkom Witel Lampung

get.description: Retrieves a list of incoming PKL registrations. Supports status filters (to differentiate between "New Registration" and "Registration History" tabs), categories (Student/Student), name search, and pagination.

parameters.description: Number of items per page (default 10, maximum 100))
parameters.name: limit

get.description: Retrieve complete details of one PKL registration based on ID, including the applicant's personal data, academic information, document files, and unit/mentor data if assigned

post.description: Generating a PKL acceptance letter in PDF format based on approved registration data. The letter is uploaded to Cloudinary and its URL is saved to the database

409.description: The letter has been created / status is not approved

patch.description: The "approved" status requires unit_id, mentor_id, and attendance_date. The "rejected" status requires admin_notes
patch.summary: Verify and Change PKL Registration Status (Admin)

get.description: Displays the number of applicants currently being processed by level (SMK/D3/D4/S1), registration trends by year, and a list of recent registrations

parameters.description: Number of past years for the trend chart (default: 5)
parameters.name: year

get.description: Displays all staff accounts (admin & employee), excluding PKL applicant accounts

put.description: Password & password confirmation are optional, leave them blank if you don't want to change the password

delete.description: Administrators cannot delete their own accounts that are being used to log in

400.description: Invalid ID / can't delete own account

get.summary: List of Mentors by Unit (for Accept modal dropdown)

get.description: Change the 'is_verified' status to true using the JWT token sent via registration email

400.description: Token is invalid, expired, or not found

get.description: Retrieve all PKL registration history belonging to the currently logged in user

post.description: Prospective participants submit academic data for internship registration

get.description: Retrieve detailed data from a PKL registration form based on submission ID

post.description: Sends OTP code to user's email if the email is registered

200.description: If your email is registered, you will receive an OTP

post.description: Perform email and password authentication to get JWT Token

503.description: Cache service unavailable (OTP cannot be issued)

post.description: Sends a new login OTP to the user's email. Requires the challenge_token from POST /login (valid for 10 minutes). Limited to once every 60 seconds. The previous OTP stops working and the attempt counter is reset.

200.description: A new OTP has been sent to your email

429.description: Please wait 2 minute before requesting a new OTP, or too many requests

post.description:
Completes the second step of login. Send the challenge_token from POST /login together with the 6-digit OTP received by email. Returns the JWT token on success.
Set "remember_device" to true to also receive a "device_token". Send it as "device_token" in later POST /login requests to skip the OTP on this device until it expires.
The OTP is valid for 5 minutes, single use, and allows at most 5 attempts.

parameters.description: Challenge token, OTP code, and optional remember_device flag
parameters.name: request

200.description: Login successful (data.token, and data.device_token if remember_device is true)

401.description: Invalid or expired challenge token, or invalid/expired OTP

429.description: Too many incorrect OTP attempts, or too many requests

get.description: Retrieve all notifications for the currently logged-in user
Retrieving the profile information details of the currently logged in student based on the JWT token

put.description: Update user profile information and/or upload a new profile photo

post.description: Create a new prospective PKL participant account in the database system
Resends a new OTP to the user's email. Requires an active OTP session (must have called /forgot-password first). Limited to once every 60 seconds.

200.description: A new OTP has been sent to your email

400.description: Invalid request body or no active OTP session

429.description: Please wait 60 seconds before requesting a new OTP

post.description: Resends an email containing an account verification link. Called by the frontend when a user attempts to log in but receives a 403 (account not verified) response. Limited to once every 120 seconds.
Replace the old password with a new password using the Reset Token obtained from OTP verification
Validates the OTP code sent to your email. If correct, it will return a Reset Token
